Spread Note: prob_underdogCovered = P(underdog covers | no push), the complement of the favorite-cover model fitted and calibrated without pushes. No push probability or unconditional EV magnitude is estimated. Three-way temporal split: models trained on the earliest ~60%, the EV threshold fitted on the next ~20% (validation), and Spread Accuracy/MAE plus Spread_OOS_Test below reported on the last ~20% (test) that tuning never saw. All in conditional P(underdog covers | no push) space.
Spread EV Note: ev_spread is conditional EV per $100 non-push stakes at assumed -110; not per original stake.
Moneyline Note: prob_underdogWon is the market implied probability. model_moneyline is trained for the accuracy/MAE/threshold diagnostics above but is not used for predictions - it has no out-of-time edge (temporal AUC ~0.56). No moneyline bets are generated.
Totals Note: prob_overHit is the market implied P(over). model_totals is trained for the diagnostics above but is not used for predictions - it is noise out-of-time (temporal AUC ~0.50). No totals bets are generated.
